name: Autonomous Translator Module, Mark II
description: The Autonomous Translator Module, Mark II, known as a talker droid or talky, was a model of linguistics droid that was active long before the time of the Galactic Empire. It was a predecessor to the 3PO-series protocol droid, though it lacked the diplomacy modules of the later models. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, the talker droid had become obsolete, though one such droid was kept as an artifact in the Imperial Museum on Coruscant.
